dedupe_keys.name: ravensburg apple cold room air surface and dew point measurements

description: This collection measures temperature and humidity within a fifty-tonne commercial apple cold room near Ravensburg, Germany. University of Bremen and collaborating researchers instrumented ten to seventeen apple bins per test during winter 2024–2025. Four tests varied ventilation runtime and temperature setpoints; two used controlled-atmosphere conditions. Mendeley version 2 supplies a ZIP containing tab-separated measurements, sensor locations, test conditions, room geometry and example MATLAB calculations, free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is one cold room, and an exact common logging interval was not established in the inspected metadata. Sensor calibration under high humidity and the difference between fruit-surface and nearby air conditions are limitations for transferring results. Modellers could calibrate refrigeration or condensation components in food-storage simulations. model-energyplus is a related building-energy tool requiring additional crop and moisture representation. No sensor readings or archive were downloaded, and no dew-point calculation or condensation prediction was reproduced.
name: Ravensburg apple cold-room air, surface and dew-point measurements
notes: G2-0490. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
